newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close near highs, helped by Dow.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close near highs, helped by Dow.

text.p: Ignoring political uncertainty, French shares finished higher for the sixth straight trading day, helped by a strong Wall Street performance.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed near its intrasession high, finishing up 1.06 percent or 28.40 points at 2,719.25 while the CAC-40 futures contract was up 16 points at 2,707
The CAC-40 index has risen 194 points since Sunday's parliamentary election vaulted the Socialists into power in an alliance with the Communist Party and Greens.
The market seesawed after publication of mixed U.S jobs data showing lower than expected job creations but a fall in the May jobless rate to 4.8 percent, the lowest level since October 1973.
The low rate contrasted with German figures showing a seasonally adjusted 11.4 percent of Germans out of work in May compared with 11.2 percent in April.
The market then picked up strength as Wall Street powered ahead. The French market was also helped by a stronger dollar.
Dealers said the market was split between those who believed the new government posed no threat to shares and those who feared its policies could be harmful to investor interests.
"We'll know more about the government's policies next week," said one. He said this week's rise had been underpinned by U.S. buying with consumer-oriented stocks particularly in favour.

* Retailer Pinault-Printemps finished up 3.50 percent at 2,630 in strong volume of 76,621 shares traded after reporting sales to end May up 7.6 percent. Brokerage Meeschaert Rousselle put shares on strong buy with price target of 2,900-3,000 by year end.

* Insurer GAN ended 1.88 pct higher at 117.1 francs after banking unit CIC announced it sold off market 1.5 million shares in energy group Total held by GAN. CIC declined to give price or identify buyer. Total up 3.11 pct at 564.

* Shares in semiconductor group SGS-Thomson Microelectronics finishes lower but off worst levels. Closed down 5.52 percent at 445.0 francs after issuing profit warning. Company said second quarter profit likely to be within range approximating first-quarter earnings of $0.65 per share.
